title: A Tail-Geometric Approach to Kotlarski's Lemma with Order Statistics
abstract: arXiv:2611.23642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a tail-geometric approach to nonparametric identification in repeated-measurement models based on large within-unit gaps. Differencing eliminates the common latent component, while conditioning on a large gap pushes the idiosyncratic errors into opposite tails. Under a regular thinner-than-Gaussian tail condition, an idiosyncratic component concentrates around a deterministic, gap-dependent location. Consequently, the corresponding observed measurement, after recentering, reveals the distribution of the common latent component up to location. The idiosyncratic distribution can then be recovered through deconvolution. This principle applies both to the classical two-measurement Kotlarski model and to settings where only order statistics are observed. Applications include auctions and wage-offer models, whether all offers are observed or only the top-ranked ones are available.

translated_title: 基于次序统计量的Kotlarski引理的尾部几何方法
translated_abstract: 我们针对基于单元内大间隔的重复测量模型非参数识别问题，提出了一种尾部几何方法。差分运算消除了共同的潜在成分，而以大间隔为条件会使个体特异误差进入相反的尾部。在正则的“薄于高斯”尾部条件下，个体特异成分会集中于一个确定性的、依赖于间隔大小的位置附近。因此，相应的观测测量在重新中心化后，可以在位置的意义上揭示共同潜在成分的分布。随后，可以通过反卷积恢复个体特异分布。这一原理既适用于经典的双测量Kotlarski模型，也适用于仅能观测到次序统计量的情形。应用场景包括拍卖模型和工资报价模型，无论是所有报价均被观测到，还是仅有排名最高的报价可用。
tldr: 该论文提出一种尾部几何方法，通过在重复测量中以大间隔为条件，实现了经典Kotlarski模型以及仅观测次序统计量情形下的非参数识别，并可应用于拍卖和工资报价模型。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a tail-geometric approach that achieves nonparametric identification in repeated-measurement models—including the classical Kotlarski model and settings with only order statistics observed—by conditioning on large within-unit gaps, with applications to auctions and wage-offer models.
